headline: Travis Scott dropped “Rodeo” 11 years ago today, and Rihanna made sure to grab THREE copie
body: Travis Scott dropped “Rodeo” 11 years ago today, and Rihanna made sure to grab THREE copies 😂🔥 She showed her support on Instagram with a stack of CDs, writing, “Finally!!!!! Got my hard copy of #RODEO” 🙌 11 years later, what’s your favorite song on the album? 💿
